about.title: Houston's local fence company.
text: HB Fence LLC is a Houston-area fence company providing professional fence installation and fence repair to homeowners and property owners across Greater Houston. We work in Houston, Channelview, Pasadena, Baytown, Pearland, Deer Park, La Porte, Cloverleaf, North Shore, and surrounding communities.

We specialize in wood privacy fences, cedar cap-and-trim, chain-link, ornamental iron, gate repair, and custom gate installation. Every project gets straight posts, clean lines, true gates, and a tidy job site. We communicate clearly from the first quote through the final walkthrough.

Our mission is to do the job right, communicate clearly, and leave your yard cleaner than we found it. From layout and post depth to hardware alignment and stain prep, our focus is straight lines and long life.
about.imageAlt: A cedar fence running the length of a back yard

values.title: Local Houston-area service
values.text: We know Houston soil, weather and HOA requirements, and we work where you live.

values.title: Clear communication
values.text: Straight quotes, honest timelines, no surprise add-ons.

values.title: Clean, reliable work
values.text: Tidy job sites, squared frames, and gate alignment checked before we leave.

facts.heading: How We Work
items: Walk-through and quote: we measure, check utilities and HOA, and provide a clear written estimate.
Layout and set posts: depth for Houston clay, true spacing, concrete set for stability.
Framing and panels: square frames, plumb posts, consistent reveals, clean top lines.
Gates and hardware: aligned hinges and latches, smooth swing, latch hits true.
Cleanup and stain: site cleaned, optional stain to protect color and lifespan.

facts.heading: Workmanship Warranty
facts.text: A workmanship warranty is available. Ask us for details with your quote.

facts.heading: Free Estimates
facts.text: Free, no-obligation estimates by text or onsite. Send your length, style and wood type, and we will call you back fast, usually within 24 hours. Every quote is itemized.

facts.heading: HOA and Permits
facts.text: We review HOA guidelines and local requirements during the quote so your project stays compliant. We prepare specs, photos and samples to streamline HOA approval, and we match profiles, heights and finishes to your community.

facts.heading: Timelines
facts.text: Most installs start within 3 to 7 days depending on materials and schedule, and most standard residential projects take about 1 to 2 days once we start. Repair work usually starts within 2 to 3 days.

facts.heading: Referral Reward
facts.text: Share your personal referral link with friends, family or neighbors. When a qualifying referred project is completed and paid in full, you earn 5% cash. An HB Fence account is needed so we can verify your email and pay the reward to the right person.

facts.heading: We Come to You
facts.text: HB Fence is a mobile service across the Houston area, so quotes and work happen at your property.

facts.heading: Licensed and Insured
facts.text: HB Fence is licensed and insured.

facts.heading: Starting Prices
items: Material grade, fence height, terrain, labor hours, and demo and disposal also affect cost
Final cost depends on length, material, gate count, soil and grading, and cleanup

facts.heading: Fence Replacement
facts.text: Replacement covers removal of the old fence, wood, chain-link and vinyl options, custom styles to fit your yard, and a workmanship warranty. We remove and dispose of the old fence as part of the job.

facts.heading: Texas811 Before We Dig
facts.text: Every project includes a utility locate request with Texas811 to mark underground lines before we set posts. Our crew follows safe digging practices, uses PPE and keeps the job site tidy, with haul-off included.

facts.heading: Every Project Includes
items: Cedar, vinyl, chain-link and iron options
Clean job site and final walkthrough

facts.heading: Commercial Fencing
facts.text: Chain-link with slats, ornamental iron and access control are available for commercial sites, alongside residential and commercial chain-link in black and galvanized.

facts.heading: Gates and Hardware
facts.text: Manual and automatic driveway and walk gates to match the fence, gate hardware packages, and gate rehang or rebuild on a repair.

facts.heading: Design Ideas and Local Guides
facts.text: A project gallery of fence design ideas, plus a blog of fencing ideas, materials, costs and local permitting tips for Greater Houston and nearby cities.

facts.heading: Every Houston Neighborhood
facts.text: We install and repair fences across all Houston neighborhoods, from the Heights, Montrose and Midtown to Spring Branch, Alief, Sharpstown, Meyerland, Westchase, Clear Lake and Kingwood, plus Bellaire, West University Place, Jacinto City and Webster.

facts.text: By sending a message you agree to be contacted about your quote. We never sell your data.

faqs.q: How fast can you install a typical backyard fence?
faqs.a: Most standard residential projects take about 1 to 2 days once we start, depending on length, terrain and gate count.
Yes, free quotes by text or onsite. Send your length, style and wood type.

faqs.q: Do you handle HOA rules and permits?
faqs.a: Yes. We review HOA guidelines and local requirements during the quote so your project stays compliant.

faqs.q: What fence materials do you recommend for Houston weather?
faqs.a: Cedar for wood, with cap-and-trim for durability, ornamental iron for security and style, and chain-link for cost-effective enclosures.
Yes, oil-based stain and seal options to protect from Houston heat and rain. We will recommend timing and finishes with your quote.

faqs.q: How long will a new fence last?
faqs.a: With quality materials, most fences last 15 to 20 years in the Houston area.
Yes, we service chain-link as well.

faqs.q: Do you remove the old fence?
faqs.a: Yes, we remove and dispose of your old fence as part of a replacement.
Cedar and powder-coated iron perform best long term, and vinyl is great for low maintenance.
Yes. Wood, chain-link, vinyl and iron options are available, including vinyl and iron upgrades on a replacement.

faqs.q: Do you work on commercial properties?
faqs.a: Yes. Chain-link with slats, iron and access control are available for commercial sites.

faqs.q: Do you match stain or paint on a repair?
faqs.a: We will get as close as possible. Weathering can cause slight color differences.

faqs.q: How quickly can repairs be scheduled?
